integrity: Proof relies on an explicit ten-vertex local replacement and graph component/rank formula. Finite combinatorial replay checks facets, double graph edges, component changes and first Betti ranks; finite verification is not substituted for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The local calculus assumes a finite pure three-dimensional simplicial complex and a stellar subdivision of a tetrahedral facet. The all-size family concerns stacked simplicial four-polytopes; no statement is made for other bistellar moves or higher-dimensional doubles. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed, and equivalent prior work under other terminology cannot be excluded.
title: Five new circles per tetrahedral stacking in simplicial doubles
